name: Elven Village

11000.name: Entrance To The Elven forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded Path Through The Forest..

east.description: To the east lies At The End Of The Trail Through The Deep, Dark Forest.

11000.description:
The grey trees of the deep forest give way here to taller, living green,
and the air changes at once, softer and full of birdsong. A gracefully
arched gate of woven living branches closes the path that leads north
into the elven forest. Beside it a slender wooden post bears a carved
leaf, the sign of the wood elves. To the east the dusty trail runs back
into the deep, dark forest.

extra_descs.carved leaf post:
The leaf is cut with great care, every vein picked out in the pale wood.
Beneath it runs a line of flowing elven script that asks travellers to
walk softly, for the trees remember.

14302.name: Guarded Path Through The Forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

east.description: To the east lies Guards room..

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Elven forest..

up.description: To the up lies On the platform..

14302.description:
Beyond the gate of branches the path is soft with moss and edged with
ferns, winding between enormous oaks. A rope ladder hangs from a
platform built up into the boughs overhead, where watchers can see far
down the trail. To the east a doorway in the trunk of a great oak opens
into the guards' room. The path carries on north into the village, and
the gate lies back to the south.

14303.name: Guards room.

east.description: To the east lies Guard chiefs bed room..

west.description: To the west lies Guarded Path Through The Forest..

14303.description:
The guards' room is cut into the hollow of a great oak, its walls hung
with longbow pegs and cloaks of mottled green. A round table bears a
carved map of the elven paths, worn smooth by the fingers of many
watches. A trapdoor in the floor opens on steps leading down to a
cellar, and a door to the east leads to the quarters of the guard chief.
The doorway west opens back onto the guarded path.

extra_descs.carved map table:
The map is carved into the tabletop itself, showing the paths, the shops
and the great trees of the village. Near its edge a patch of the wood
has been stained black and scored through with angry marks, where the
tainted forest lies.

11001.name: Guard chiefs bed room.

west.description: To the west lies Guards room..

11001.description:
The guard chief sleeps in this plain, orderly chamber. A narrow bed of
woven rope is made up tight beneath a grey wool blanket, and a chest at
its foot is carved with the sign of the leaf and arrow. An empty helm
stand waits beside a small washstand. The door to the west leads back
into the guards' room.

14305.name: Cellar.

up.description: To the up lies Guards room..

14305.description:
The cellar is dug in among the roots of the oak, cool and dim, its
earthen sides braced with curved ribs of living wood. Casks of wine and
strings of dried apples crowd the shelves, and sacks of grain are
stacked against the far side. Roots poke through the ceiling, beaded
with damp. Wooden steps lead up through a trapdoor to the guards' room.

14306.name: On the platform.

down.description: To the down lies Guarded Path Through The Forest..

14306.description:
High among the branches, this wide platform of planks is lashed to the
limbs of a great oak and open to the sky. From here the forest spreads
away in a rolling green sea, the gate and the trail beyond it visible
far below between the leaves. A railing of woven boughs runs around the
edge, and a rope ladder drops down to the guarded path. The wind sways
the whole platform gently, and the leaves whisper all around.

14307.name: Guarded path through the forest.

north.description: To the north lies Path crossing..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded Path Through The Forest..

14307.description:
Lanterns of pale green glass hang from low branches along this stretch
of path, unlit in the green daylight. The trees press close, their
trunks wound about with flowering vine, and the ground is carpeted with
last year's leaves. Here and there a narrow slit has been cut in a
living trunk, a sign of how carefully the elves watch their road. The
path runs north to a crossing and south toward the gate.

14308.name: Path crossing.

north.description: To the north lies A fine path through the elven forest..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

14308.description:
Two paths once crossed in this little clearing, but the side ways have
been let go, closed off by a hedge of thorn and holly woven tight
between the trunks. A ring of pale stones marks the old crossing, and a
weathered wooden signpost still stands at its centre, its arms carved in
elven script. The open path leads north toward the village and south
toward the gate. Sunlight falls through the canopy in shifting coins.

extra_descs.signpost sign arms:
The signpost has four carved arms, but two of them, pointing at the
hedged-off ways, have been sawn short and capped with wax. The remaining
arms name the gate and the village in graceful elven letters.

11014.name: A fine path through the elven forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

east.description: To the east lies The Elven Armory..

south.description: To the south lies Path crossing..

west.description: To the west lies The Elven Weaponry..

11014.description:
The path becomes a fine one here, laid with flat stones fitted between
the roots and swept clean. On the east side a shop grown from a living
oak shows a carved breastplate above its door, the elven armory, and
opposite, to the west, crossed blades of wood mark the weaponry. The
path runs north between more of the guarded trees, and south toward the
crossing. Bright leaf-light dapples everything.

11002.name: The Elven Armory.

west.description: To the west lies A fine path through the elven forest..

11002.description:
Elven armour of rare grace fills this shop: mail as fine as fish scales,
breastplates of lacquered leaf-green leather, and helms crested with
carved wings. Each piece hangs on a stand of living wood that grows up
from the floor. A workbench at the back is laid out with awls and rivets
beside a small, clean forge of stone. The doorway west returns to the
fine path.

11003.name: The Elven Weaponry.

east.description: To the east lies A fine path through the elven forest..

11003.description:
Blades of every elven kind line the walls of this weaponry, from slender
leaf-shaped swords to long knives and spears tipped with bright steel. A
grindstone stands in one corner, and the smell of oil and whetstone
hangs in the air. The weapons rest in racks carved like curling vines.
The doorway east leads back onto the fine path between the shops.

14312.name: A fine path through the elven forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

east.description: To the east lies The Magic Shop..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

west.description: To the west lies Quintor's Fine Shop.

14312.description:
Two more shops face each other across the fine path here. To the east a
doorway hung with silver leaves and faintly glowing glass marks the
magic shop, while to the west the smell of fresh-cut yew and glue drifts
from Quintor's Fine Shop, where bows are made. Lanterns of carved horn
line the way, and the stones are swept spotless. The path runs on north
and back south between the guarded trees.

11006.name: Quintor's Fine Shop
11006.description:
This ground-level workshop is dedicated to the craft of bow and arrow
making. Racks hold dozens of bows in various stages of completion - some
just shaped wood, others finished masterpieces. Bundles of arrows sorted
by type fill barrels. Feathers, sinew, glue, and exotic woods cover
every work surface. A master fletcher works here, creating weapons of
legendary quality. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. The
ceiling hangs low overhead.

east.description: To the east lies A fine path through the elven forest..

11007.name: The Magic Shop.

west.description: To the west lies A fine path through the elven forest..

11007.description:
Shelves of glass vials, dried herbs and polished stones fill the magic
shop, and the air hums faintly with something that is not quite sound.
Silver leaves hang from threads across the ceiling, turning slowly
though there is no breeze. A counter of pale wood holds a crystal ball
resting on a stand of twisted roots. The doorway to the west opens back
onto the fine path.

11010.name: The end of the fine path.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

east.description: To the east lies The Tavern of Hope.

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

11010.description:
The fine path ends in a wide, mossy glade around a tree older than
anything else in the village, its bark furrowed like a face. To the east
a welcoming doorway in a hollow trunk is hung with a painted sign of a
rising sun, the Tavern of Hope. Beyond the glade to the north the
guarded path goes on as a plain earth track, and to the south it climbs
back toward the lookout. Warm lantern light spills from the tavern door.

14316.name: The Tavern of Hope

west.description: To the west lies The end of the fine path..

up.description: To the up lies The Reception in the Tavern of the hope..

14316.description:
The Tavern of Hope is built inside a great hollow tree, its common room
ringed by benches carved from the living wood. A long bar of polished
walnut curves around one side, and barrels of elven wine and honey mead
are racked behind it. Lanterns hang from the roots that thread the
ceiling, and a stair winds up to the reception. The doorway west leads
out into the glade at the end of the fine path.

14317.name: Inside the fine house.

east.description: To the east lies Trophy room of the Elven King..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

west.description: To the west lies Guard room..

up.description: To the up lies The grand stairs..

14317.description:
This fine house is grown rather than built, its walls the living curve
of a vast hollow tree, polished to a honey gleam. A carpet of woven
rushes covers the floor, and lanterns of amber glass hang in the
vaulting. To the east an archway opens into the trophy room of the Elven
King, while a door to the west leads to the guard room, from which a
smell of rot creeps in. A grand stair winds up through the trunk, and
the doorway south opens on the darkening path.

11012.name: Guard room.
11012.description:
Something is terribly wrong here. The trees are twisted and blackened,
their leaves withered and dead. The ground is covered in sickly moss
that squelches underfoot. Dark magic has tainted this place, and the
corruption is spreading slowly toward the village. Corrupted sprites
flit through the dying trees, and shadow stalkers hunt in the darkness.
The elves are greatly concerned. Shadows gather in the corners. The
walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch.

east.description: To the east lies Inside the fine house..

14319.name: Trophy room of the Elven King.

west.description: To the west lies Inside the fine house..

14319.description:
The trophies of the Elven King fill this round chamber: antlers of great
stags, the skull of a horned beast, a black spear taken from some
forgotten foe, and tattered banners won from the servants of shadow.
Each trophy rests on a bracket of living wood with a small carved plaque
beneath. A tall window of thin, leaf-green glass softens the light. The
archway to the west leads back into the house.

extra_descs.plaque plaques:
Each plaque names the trophy, the year it was taken and the hand that
took it, in tiny elven script. The plaque beneath the black spear is
blank, as though no one wished to remember.

14320.name: The grand stairs.

up.description: To the up lies The upper floor of the house..

down.description: To the down lies Inside the fine house..

14320.description:
The grand stairs spiral up through the heart of the tree, each step a
shelf of living wood grown from the inner wall. A handrail of twisted
vine guides the hand, and small round windows let in spots of green
daylight. Carved figures of elven heroes stand in niches along the
climb. The stair rises to the upper floor and descends to the hall of
the fine house below.

14321.name: The upper floor of the house.

north.description: To the north lies The Library..

east.description: To the east lies The corridor..

south.description: To the south lies The Livingroom..

down.description: To the down lies The grand stairs..

14321.description:
The upper floor of the house opens into a round landing beneath a domed
ceiling of interlaced branches. To the north stands a doorway framed by
shelves of books, the library, and to the south a curtain of wooden
beads leads into the livingroom. A corridor runs off east, and the grand
stairs wind down through the floor. Everything here smells of beeswax
and old wood.

14322.name: The corridor.

north.description: To the north lies Guards bed room..

south.description: To the south lies The Training room..

west.description: To the west lies The upper floor of the house..

14322.description:
This curving corridor follows the outer wall of the tree, lit by small
round lamps of pale glass. A door to the north leads to the guards' bed
room, but a chill breath and a faint smell of decay seep from beneath
it. To the south, the clack of wood on wood seems to echo from the
training room even when it is empty. The landing lies back to the west.

14323.name: The Library.

south.description: To the south lies The upper floor of the house..

14323.description:
Shelves grow straight out of the curved walls of the library, crowded
with scrolls, leather books and bundles of bark bound in green cord. A
reading desk stands beneath a round window, its surface ink-stained and
worn. Soft cushions lie heaped in a nook where the wood bulges inward.
The doorway to the south leads back onto the landing.

14324.name: The Livingroom.

north.description: To the north lies The upper floor of the house..

14324.description:
The livingroom is a soft, quiet place, furnished with low couches of
carved wood heaped with cushions of moss-green velvet. A hearth of
smooth river stones stands against one wall, its chimney a hollow branch
rising through the ceiling. Painted screens of birds and leaves divide
the room into cosy nooks. The way north leads back to the landing at the
top of the stairs.

11013.name: Guards bed room.
11013.description:
At the center of the corrupted grove lies the source - a massive dead
tree, its trunk split open to reveal pulsing darkness within. This was
once a sacred tree, but something has twisted it into an abomination.
Shadow energy radiates from it like heat from a fire. Defeating the
corruption here might save the grove, but the source of darkness is
powerful and well-defended. The air is still and musty. Dust motes drift
in the stale air.

south.description: To the south lies The corridor..

14327.name: The Training room.

north.description: To the north lies The corridor..

14327.description:
This broad room is given over to the practice of arms. Its floor is laid
with springy rush mats, and straw-stuffed targets stand against the far
wall, pocked with arrow holes. Racks of wooden practice swords and
staves line the walls, and a carved chart of sword forms is set beside
the door. The corridor lies through the doorway to the north.

11004.name: Guarded path through the forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

south.description: To the south lies A fine path through the elven forest..

11004.description:
Elven homes begin to show among the branches here: round doorways high
in the trunks, joined by swaying walkways of rope and plank. Below them
the guarded path winds on, its stones edged with moss. A carved bench
curves around the foot of a great beech where villagers rest. The way
leads north deeper into the village and south back to the fine path by
the shops.

11005.name: Guarded path through the forest.

north.description: To the north lies A fine path through the elven forest..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

11005.description:
Music seems to linger in this part of the path, perhaps from the wind
chimes of polished wood and shell hanging among the leaves. A walkway
passes overhead, its rails twined with vines that drop small white
flowers on the stones below. The guarded path continues north toward
more shops and south through the village. A spring trickles from a stone
basin set into the roots of a tree.

11008.name: Guarded path through the forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

south.description: To the south lies A fine path through the elven forest..

11008.description:
The path begins to climb here, rising on a ramp of living roots toward a
lookout built out from a great tree to the north. Children have left
chalk drawings of birds and stars on the flat of a stone. Leaves hang
thick overhead, and the light comes green and gold through them. To the
south the path drops back to the shops of the fine path.

11009.name: Guarded path through the forest.
11009.description:
This platform extends far out from the main tree, providing an
unobstructed view in all directions. Elven scouts use this post to watch
for intruders. A spyglass on a swivel mount allows observation of
distant locations. From here, Visible is the boundaries of elven
territory and beyond - the forest, the swamp to the south, and mountains
to the east. The walls are rough-hewn and cold to the touch. Shadows
gather in the corners.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

14332.name: Guarded path through the forest.

north.description: To the north lies The end of the fine path..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

14332.description:
Past the lookout the guarded path descends again among ancient trees
whose roots rise in arches higher than a man. The stones underfoot are
older here, mossed over and sunk deep. A guard's niche has been carved
into one great trunk, empty and swept clean. The path goes on north to
the end of the fine path, and south back up to the lookout platform.

14333.name: Guarded path through the forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

south.description: To the south lies The end of the fine path..

14333.description:
Here the path is only trodden earth, and the trees grow closer and
wilder. The guards have hung little bells of carved wood on cords across
the branches, so that anything passing above will set them clacking.
Ferns crowd the verge, and the birdsong is quieter than in the village.
The way runs north into thicker forest and south back to the glade at
the end of the fine path.

14334.name: Guarded path through the forest.

north.description: To the north lies Guarded path through the forest..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

14334.description:
A creeping wrongness enters the forest here. Some of the leaves along
the path are spotted with black, and a young birch beside the way has
twisted in on itself as if in pain. The elves have tied ribbons of
silver around the healthy trunks, and the path is watched more closely.
North, the shadow deepens toward the boundary of the village, while
south lies the safer path.

11011.name: Guarded path through the forest.
11011.description:
The forest grows darker here, the trees closer together and their
branches more entangled. This path marks the boundary between the
protected village and the wild forest beyond. Elven magic keeps
corruption at bay, but it's a constant struggle. Strange sounds echo
from deeper in the woods, and shadows move in ways they shouldn't. The
elves post guards here day and night. Dust motes drift in the stale air.
Shadows gather in the corners.

north.description: To the north lies Inside the fine house..

south.description: To the south lies Guarded path through the forest..

14390.name: The Reception in the Tavern of the hope.

down.description: To the down lies The Tavern of Hope.

14390.description:
A small reception desk of carved oak stands in this round room above the
tavern, with a row of brass hooks for room keys on the wall behind it.
Doors to the guest rooms are set around the curve of the wall, each
painted with a different flower. A window looks out into the leaves, and
the murmur of the common room drifts up through the floor. The stair
leads back down to the Tavern of Hope.

11001.name: elf
11001.long_desc: An elven villager goes about their daily tasks.

11002.name: guard
11002.long_desc: An elven guard stands watch, bow at the ready.

11003.name: elder
11003.long_desc: A wise elven elder sits in contemplation.

11004.name: merchant
11004.long_desc: An elven merchant displays fine crafts and goods.

11005.name: child
11005.long_desc: An elven child plays among the trees.

11006.name: ranger
11006.long_desc: An elven ranger patrols the village perimeter.

11007.name: healer
11007.long_desc: An elven healer tends to herbs and poultices.

11008.name: spider
11008.long_desc: A large spider has wandered in from the forest.

11098.name: elven bard
11098.long_desc: An elven bard sits upon a mossy stone here, fingers dancing across a silver-stringed lute.
11098.description: Her voice carries an otherworldly beauty that makes the very leaves lean closer to listen. Centuries of wisdom lie behind her ageless eyes, and her music seems to make the forest itself breathe deeper.

talk_responses.hello: The bard's melody fades to silence. 'Silversong was ancient when the first humans drew breath. Every tree here remembers the world's beginning. The corruption in the dark forest to the south is a wound that festers — we sing to keep it from spreading. Listen to the trees, traveler. They whisper warnings to those who know how to hear.'
talk_responses.history: She strums a mournful chord. 'A great evil was sealed beneath these roots long ago. The singing keeps the seal strong. If the music ever stops... well. That is why we bards never rest.'
talk_responses.default: The elven bard plays a haunting melody that fills you with both joy and an inexplicable sadness.
talk_responses.next: Lyralei plucks a melancholy chord. 'The forest's melody grows darker further north. But if you seek challenge beyond these woods, the Mines of Moria echo with the clash of steel, and the Dark Forest... well, few return unchanged from that place.'

11099.name: ancient treant
11099.long_desc: An enormous treant stands here, so still it could be mistaken for a particularly gnarled oak.
11099.description: Centuries of growth have given it a face-like pattern in its bark, and its 'eyes' — two deep knotholes — seem to follow movement with glacial patience. Moss hangs from its branches like a green beard.

talk_responses.hello: The treant speaks with a voice like grinding boulders. '...Hmmm. Small thing. Fast thing. You move... too quickly. The forest... has roots deeper than mountains. Patience... is the oldest strength. The dark ones... from below... they cut and burn. Stop them... if you can. We are... too slow... to fight.'
talk_responses.forest: Bark creaks as it shifts. '...The silver trees... are the heart. Protect... the heart... and the forest... survives. Harm the heart... and all... falls to shadow.'
talk_responses.default: The treant is utterly still. You're not even sure it's awake.

11000.name: elven bread
11000.long_desc: A wrapped loaf of pale bread sits here.
11000.description: This is lembas, the waybread of the elves. One small bite fills the belly and restores energy. It stays fresh for months without spoiling. The elves give this to travelers setting out on long journeys.

11001.name: healing potion
11001.long_desc: A crystal vial filled with glowing water sits here.
11001.description: This vial contains water drawn from the sacred moonwell. It glows with soft silver light and has powerful healing properties. One sip can cure wounds and purge poison from the body.

11002.name: elven cloak
11002.long_desc: A cloak of forest green hangs from a peg.
11002.description: This cloak is woven from spider silk and enchanted fibers. It's incredibly light and practically weightless, yet provides surprising warmth. The color shifts subtly to match surroundings, granting its wearer improved concealment in natural settings.

11003.name: nature's tear
11003.long_desc: A crystal that looks like a frozen teardrop glows softly.
11003.description: This crystal formed from a treant's tears, shed in sorrow over the corruption of the grove. It holds powerful nature magic and could be used to purify tainted land - or crafted into a powerful magical item by a skilled enchanter.

11010.name: elven longbow
11010.long_desc: A beautiful longbow of white wood rests in a display.
11010.description: This bow is a work of art and a deadly weapon. Made from ancient yew wood and reinforced with magic, it's both powerful and graceful. Elvish runes etched along its length glow faintly. The bowstring is woven from unicorn hair. In the hands of a skilled archer, this bow is deadly at incredible range.

11011.name: quiver of arrows
11011.long_desc: A leather quiver filled with arrows hangs here.
11011.description: This quiver contains two dozen arrows of elven make. Each is perfectly straight and balanced, fletched with hawk feathers. The arrowheads are steel, sharp enough to pierce armor. These arrows fly true and hit hard.

11012.name: short bow
11012.long_desc: A compact bow of dark wood rests here.
11012.description: This short bow is lighter and more maneuverable than a longbow, perfect for use in forests where space is limited. While it lacks the range of a longbow, it's easier to use and faster to draw.

11013.name: leather armor
11013.short_desc: a suit of elven leather armor
11013.long_desc: Finely crafted leather armor hangs on display.
11013.description: This armor is made from the finest leather, supple yet strong. It's been treated with oils and magic to enhance its protective qualities while maintaining flexibility. The craftsmanship is superb - every seam perfect, every buckle secure.

11018.name: elven focus crystal
11018.room_desc: An elven focus crystal lies here.

11000.name: elven archer
11000.long_desc: An elf in forest green leather draws an arrow with fluid grace.
11000.description: This elf embodies the grace and deadliness of their people. Tall and slim with the ageless beauty of elvenkind, they move with liquid fluidity. Their longbow is a masterwork of wood and magic, and a quiver of arrows hangs at their hip. Centuries of practice have made them a legendary marksman. Their eyes are alert, missing nothing.

11001.name: treant
11001.long_desc: An enormous tree-like being stands here, its bark-covered form radiating ancient power.
11001.description: This treant is one of the oldest living things in the forest. Standing over twenty feet tall, it appears to be an ancient oak tree - until it moves. Massive limbs serve as arms, and roots pull free of the earth to become legs. Its face is carved into the trunk, with eyes like knotholes that glow with inner light. It speaks in a voice like wind through branches, slow and deliberate. The treant guards the ancient grove with unwavering dedication.

11002.name: corrupted sprite
11002.long_desc: A small winged creature flits about erratically, trailing dark mist.
11002.description: This sprite was once a beautiful nature spirit, but corruption has twisted it into something ugly. Its wings are tattered and leak black ichor, and its eyes glow with malevolent red light. Where normal sprites trail stardust and bring joy, this one spreads decay and misery. The corruption that took the grove also claimed these innocent spirits, turning them into agents of darkness.

11003.name: shadow stalker
11003.short_desc: a shadowy figure that moves like smoke
11003.long_desc: A creature of living darkness hunts silently through the corrupted grove.
11003.description: This being seems to be made of shadow given form and malice. It has a vaguely humanoid shape but no distinct features - just darkness in the outline of a predator. When it moves, it flows like smoke, silent and deadly. Red eyes gleam in the void of its head. These creatures are spawn of the corruption, feeding on life and light to sustain their unnatural existence.

11004.name: village elder
11004.long_desc: An ancient elf studies a tome with eyes that have seen centuries pass.
11004.description: Silvithiel is impossibly old even by elven standards. Her silver hair flows like moonlight, and her eyes hold the wisdom of ages. Despite her apparent frailty, power radiates from her like heat from a flame. She is the keeper of lore, advisor to the people, and guardian of ancient secrets. She worries deeply about the spreading corruption and seeks heroes brave enough to face it.

11005.name: master fletcher
11005.long_desc: A skilled elf carefully shapes a bow with expert hands.
11005.description: Aerendil has devoted his long life to the craft of bow-making. His hands move with the precision of centuries of practice, shaping wood into instruments of deadly beauty. He can judge the quality of wood at a glance and knows which trees will yield the finest bows. His shop contains the finest ranged weapons in the realm.

11006.name: wolf
11006.long_desc: A gray wolf watches you with intelligent eyes.
11006.description: This wolf is larger and more intelligent than normal. It moves with fluid grace, muscles rippling under its thick fur. These wolves sometimes bond with worthy rangers, becoming loyal companions for life. This one seems interested in you, evaluating whether you're worthy of its loyalty.

11007.name: hawk
11007.long_desc: A hawk perches on a branch, its keen eyes scanning for prey.
11007.description: This hawk is a magnificent specimen with sharp talons and piercing eyes. Hawks make excellent companions for rangers, serving as scouts and messengers. This one seems unusually intelligent and might bond with the right person.

description: An ancient elven settlement among the trees
author: Misthollow Team
